docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $450.00 FILED BY MCGURTY, PETER AS TO DEFENDANT DOMINSKY, JANICE ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAR-15-1993 AT 07:00 PM IN DEPT 01
